headline: New possibilities for a familiar address.
intro: Looking for an interior designer for a Chandigarh home or workplace? DMS Studio serves Chandigarh from its Sunny Enclave studio in Mohali, providing residential interiors, renovations, commercial layouts and agreed turnkey execution. Share your plan, site photos and priorities to discuss a suitable scope. The photographed projects below are nearby Mohali work, clearly labelled with their real locations.
heading: Thinking through a Chandigarh renovation
sections: Document what already works

For an existing home, separate the features worth retaining from the changes you need. Photograph storage, electrical points and areas showing wear. A measured survey is more reliable than assuming an old drawing matches the property today.
Make alterations a separate decision

Aesthetic changes, service changes and structural alterations require different checks. Discuss proposed wall changes and any relevant property or building approvals before execution. Interior concepts do not replace advice from a qualified structural professional where it is needed.
Plan for life during the work

If you intend to remain at home, discuss room-by-room access, dust protection, temporary storage and the availability of a kitchen or bathroom. The practical sequence of work can matter as much as the final palette.
faqs: Does DMS Studio work in Chandigarh?
Yes. Chandigarh is part of our service area. The studio is based in Mohali; contact us with your Chandigarh property address and scope to discuss the next step.
Can I retain existing furniture in a renovation?
Yes, existing pieces can form part of the brief. Share dimensions and photographs so the proposed layout, finishes and new storage can be considered around them.

The project linked below is Babbar Residency in Mohali. It illustrates the studio’s residential approach and is not presented as a Chandigarh commission.

headline: Everyday living, thoughtfully resolved.
intro: DMS Studio offers interior design in Kharar from its Sunny Enclave studio. We help shape residential spaces, modular kitchens, wardrobes and complete interiors around the way a household uses its home.
heading: A practical brief for your Kharar home
sections: Start with storage, not a catalogue

List what needs to be stored in each room, including luggage, cleaning equipment and occasional-use items. Decide which items should be visible and which should be behind doors. This gives wardrobe and cabinet layouts a purpose before choosing a laminate.
Check the property before committing to finishes

Record the condition of walls, services and window openings during the site review. Discuss any signs of dampness or service problems before covering surfaces. Decorative work should follow an agreed plan for resolving underlying issues.
Make kitchen decisions together

Appliance sizes, countertop height, sockets, plumbing and cabinet openings affect one another. Bring appliance details to the layout conversation so the kitchen can be coordinated as a whole. A realistic brief distinguishes essential fittings from optional accessories.

headline: Space for the way your family lives.
intro: DMS Studio serves Panchkula with residential and commercial interior design from its Mohali base. Our starting point is your brief: the people using the space, the routines it needs to support and the extent of work you want to undertake.
heading: Planning a home for shared and private routines
sections: Give shared rooms more than one purpose

A living room may need to host visitors, family evenings and occasional work. Discuss seating, circulation and accessible power together. A furniture plan can reveal conflicts before you invest in fixed joinery or a large dining table.
Keep private rooms genuinely personal

Bedroom layouts should reflect who uses them. Consider bedside lighting, wardrobe access, study areas and the space needed to move comfortably. Requirements for children, guests or older family members belong in the brief before the style discussion.
Use daylight as a design input

Visit rooms at different times and photograph how light reaches the surfaces. Review finish samples in the intended room wherever possible. Curtains, reflective surfaces and task lighting should respond to that specific space rather than a generic moodboard.
faqs: Do you provide interior design in Panchkula?
Yes. Panchkula is part of the studio’s service area. We are based in Mohali and discuss site access and the project scope before planning work.
Can you plan a home for several generations?

Share each household member’s needs during the brief. Room use, storage, lighting and movement can then be reviewed together; specialist accessibility requirements should be assessed for the individual.

This website lists one studio address in Sunny Enclave, Kharar, Mohali. Panchkula is a service area, not a separately claimed office.

headline: Make every part of your apartment count.
intro: DMS Studio provides interior design services for Zirakpur, including home layouts, modular storage, kitchens and turnkey interiors. For an apartment or a newly handed-over property, the first step is to understand the actual site and your move-in priorities.
heading: From possession to a usable home
sections: Compare the handover plan with the site

Check dimensions, column positions, doors and service points before finalising furniture or cabinetry. Record the items the builder is handing over and the items your interior scope must supply. This helps prevent gaps and duplicate work.
Confirm building access before scheduling

Ask the building team about work hours, lift use, delivery access, debris removal and any fit-out permissions. These are property-specific conditions to confirm, not assumptions a design proposal should make. Share them with the studio early.
Choose adaptable furniture around fixed storage

In a compact apartment, deep joinery and oversized seating can reduce usable circulation. Begin with the largest fixed elements, then check dining-chair pull-out, wardrobe openings and the route through the room. Prioritise what supports daily use.
faqs: Can you help with interiors after apartment possession in Zirakpur?
Yes. Share the handover status, plan and desired scope. Measurements and existing services should be checked before approving the final interior layout.
How long will an apartment interior take?

There is no reliable single duration for every home. Scope, site condition, selections, approvals, procurement and access affect the schedule. Ask for a project-specific programme after these are defined.
Can we begin while living outside India?
Opera Home provides a documented example of remote coordination for an NRI client. Contact the studio to discuss communication, approvals and local site access for your own project.

headline: A clear identity for spaces people return to.

heading: Designing around the visitor experience
sections: Map the experience from the entrance

For a salon, studio or office, identify where visitors arrive, wait, meet staff and receive a service. Keep staff movement, stock and cleaning needs in the same plan. An attractive reception should also help the business operate clearly.
Make light serve the work

A commercial scheme needs to balance atmosphere with the visibility required for its tasks. Discuss equipment, working positions, mirrors and screen locations before lighting layouts are fixed. Electrical requirements should be coordinated with qualified professionals.
Connect identity to practical finishes

The material palette should reflect the business without ignoring maintenance. Review sample finishes, cleaning expectations and the areas likely to receive frequent use. Essentia Salon is a starting point for discussing this balance, not a template every business should repeat.
